issue.title: Cut athena's SSD writes from SASE's own churn
issue.description: SASE stops rewriting large derived state on athena's root NVMe. The runner-slot capacity cache shrinks from ~104 MB to under ~1 MB. Codex launches stop rebuilding a 347 MB thread index (and start ~3 minutes sooner). The corrupt bead read-model cache heals itself instead of rebuilding and rolling back on every read. sase-core test builds link ~2.9 GB less per cycle. No admission decision, Codex transcript, or bead read result changes.

issue.title: Self-heal the corrupt bead read-model cache
issue.description: core-read-model-heal: in sase-core's bead read model, classify SQLITE_CORRUPT write faults and repair them by REINDEX or an in-place table recreate. Stop swallowing invalidation failures, back off after failed rebuilds, never downgrade a newer cache, and add a regression test that reproduces athena's corrupt meta index.
